+class Members::OmniauthCallbacksController < Devise::OmniauthCallbacksController
+  def google_oauth2
+    member = Member.from_google(**from_google_params)
+
+    if member.present?
+      sign_out_all_scopes
+      sign_in_and_redirect member, event: :authentication
+    else
+      redirect_to new_member_session_path,
+        alert: "Please sign in/up with your Texas A&M account."
+    end
+  end
+
+  protected
+
+  def after_omniauth_failure_path_for(_scope)
+    new_member_session_path
+  end
+
+  private
+
+  def from_google_params
+    {
+      uid: auth.uid,
+      email: auth.info.email,
+      first_name: auth.info.first_name,
+      last_name: auth.info.last_name,
+      avatar_url: auth.info.image
+    }
+  end
+
+  def auth
+    @auth ||= request.env["omniauth.auth"]
+  end
+end

+class MembersController < ApplicationController
+  before_action :require_completed_profile
+  before_action :require_admin
+
+  def index
+    @members = Member.includes(:role).order(:last_name, :first_name)
+  end

+  def update
+    member = Member.find(params[:id])
+
+    if member.update(member_params)
+      redirect_to members_path, notice: "#{member.first_name}'s dues updated."
+    else
+      redirect_to members_path, alert: "Could not update #{member.first_name}."
+    end
+  end
+
+  private
+
+  # Only the fields admins are allowed to change from the dashboard
+  def member_params
+    params.require(:member).permit(:paid_dues)
+  end
+end

+class ProfilesController < ApplicationController
+  def edit
+    @member = current_member
+  end
+
+  def update
+    @member = current_member
+    @member.assign_attributes(profile_params)
+    @member.profile_completed_at ||= Time.current
+
+    if @member.save(context: :profile)
+      redirect_to root_path, notice: "Profile saved."
+    else
+      render :edit, status: :unprocessable_entity
+    end
+  end
+
+  private
+
+  # Only fields the member may change. Never role_id or points.
+  def profile_params
+    params.require(:member).permit(:first_name, :last_name,
+                                   :pt_school_application_date, :car_pool_status)
+  end
+end

 class Member < ApplicationRecord
-  has_many :rsvps
+  ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN = "@tamu.edu".freeze
+
+  devise :omniauthable, omniauth_providers: [ :google_oauth2 ]
+
+  belongs_to :role
+  has_many :rsvps, dependent: :destroy
+  has_many :attendances, dependent: :destroy
+
+  validates :pt_school_application_date, presence: true, on: :profile
+  validates :email, presence: true
+
+  def profile_completed?
+    profile_completed_at.present?
+  end
+
+  def admin?
+    role&.description == "Admin"
+  end
+
+  def self.from_google(email:, first_name:, last_name:, uid:, avatar_url:)
+    email = email.to_s.downcase.strip
+    return nil unless email.end_with?(ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN)
+
+    member = find_or_initialize_by(email: email)
+    member.uid = uid
+    member.avatar_url = avatar_url
+
+    if member.new_record?
+      member.first_name = first_name.to_s
+      member.last_name  = last_name.to_s
+      member.role       = Role.find_or_create_by!(description: "Member")
+      member.joined_at  = Date.current
+    end
+
+    member.save ? member : nil
+  end
 end
